name: boltons-unique-integers-equivalence
rationale: The upstream unique docstring in boltons 26.2.0 (release commit 4332b35a278d694f30c99881faa61cde695c7a96, boltons/iterutils.py lines 820-849) promises first-occurrence order and removal of duplicate values, with key=None using values themselves. The independent oracle uses nested equality comparisons and appends only first occurrences; it does not call boltons, unique_iter, set, or dict. Official documentation: https://boltons.readthedocs.io/en/latest/iterutils.html#boltons.iterutils.unique .
domain: Lists of Python integers, length 0 through 80, with duplicates and arbitrary order allowed. The strategy mixes a dense -8..8 integer branch (to exercise repeats) with unrestricted Python integers. Excludes floats/NaN, unhashable items, custom equality objects, and custom key functions.
